item: The dossier seed (gate 0.5 row K, brief S05-11 S4): one Wikidata item's page joining news and web, Wikipedia, law, Places and the map by QID, naming the rails it does not join, with the corpus passport (A-1)
status: SHIPPED (Chromium-verified in en and ar; awaiting human UX pass)
key_paths: src/entities/dossier.py; src/analytics/passport.py; src/api/entities.py; src/static/app-dossier.js; src/static/app-analysis.js; src/static/index.html; tests/test_dossier_seed.py; docs/audit/dossier-seed-2026-09-29/
summary: GET /api/entities/dossier?qid= returns the item (label and description from the local Wikidata cache, the reader's language first), three join routes each with its count and what it matched on (a named entity resolving to exactly this item, a keyword that is this item's name in its own language and no other item's, a place mention resolving to a Place carrying it), the union split by channel into news and web, Wikipedia and law, the Wikipedia lane's pages, the Places and the OpenStreetMap lane's objects tagged with it, and three rails named as not joined with why (markets, agenda, tracked law texts). The passport counts articles, sources, countries, languages and the date span over a SELECT (no cap), and counts the articles missing a country, a language or a date instead of dropping them. Opened from the place card and from a Who chip on the spine; a name two items share gets no button. Local reads only.
